in_hebrew.name: Worthington
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Worthington הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English 'worth' (worth) and 'ing' (town), translating to 'farmstead town'. The name Worthington has a rich historical background, as it was a common name for those who lived in or owned land in rural areas during the Middle Ages.
